records.title: Dimension-Free Classical Simulation Under Correlated Inputs: Wyner Common-Information Bounds and Query-Local Representations
records.author: Devin J. Wright
records.publication_status: published on Zenodo, confirmed by owner's screenshot
records.review_status: AI-assisted mathematical review; external human peer review not established
records.summary: Connects the common information of correlated inputs to classical acceptance-estimation query bounds, and studies how recoverable latent representations can change those bounds.
records.scope: Original-coordinate query complexity under the stated finite-law and oracle assumptions; not a general runtime or quantum-state simulation theorem. The exact archived manuscript-to-Lean correspondence is not established here.

records.title: Quadratic Influence Beyond the Boolean Cube: A Bias-Free, Exponent-Two Bound on Product Probability Spaces
records.author: Devin J. Wright
records.publication_status: Published on Zenodo; DOI and title confirmed by owner. Live record and archived file bytes not independently verified.
records.review_status: AI-assisted mathematical review; external human peer review not established
records.summary: Establishes a variance-squared maximum-coordinate influence inequality for bounded degree-two functions on product probability spaces, without a dimension or bias penalty under the stated hypotheses.
records.scope: The related finite-product theorem has a named Lean evidence trail. No claim is made here that every statement in the archived PDF has an exact matching kernel receipt.
